description: This PHP source file defines a Controller class for managing product comparison features in an OpenCart-based e-commerce application. It includes methods for displaying the comparison page, adding products to compare, and handling related session and rendering logic.

classes.name: Compare
classes.description: Controller class managing the product comparison page, including adding/removing products and rendering the comparison view.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the display of the product comparison page, including fetching product details, constructing the comparison data, and rendering the view.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Handles AJAX requests to add a product to the comparison list, managing session data, and returning JSON response.
